trials.claim: Lifetime access to Switchy is included
trials.claimQuote:
So make the switch today!

Get lifetime access to Switchy.io now!
trials.reasoning: A buyer reports using Switchy for six years after purchase, and another says the team stuck to its AppSumo commitment. The single report speculating its account may have been deleted does not materially outweigh that long-term use.

exhibits.quote: It's also possible that my account was deleted and I cannot use my codes again.
exhibits.argument: Account deletion with unusable codes contradicts lifetime access.

exhibits.quote: I bought Switchy six years ago and have been using it across campaigns ever since.
exhibits.argument: Quote confirms lifetime access in practice by showing continuous use six years after purchase.

exhibits.quote: Props to the team for not abandoning the app and sticking to their AppSumo commitment.
exhibits.argument: Quote confirms the vendor honored its lifetime AppSumo commitment over time.

trials.claim: 1 Code plan includes 30,000 clicks per month, 8 custom domains, 2 smartpages and 10 team members
trials.claimQuote:
- 30,000 Clicks/month
- 8 Custom domain(s)
- 2 (with logo) Smartpages
- 10 Team members
- Messenger links
- Multiple workspaces
- Full tracking
trials.reasoning: The only exhibit mentions a new workspace not accepting links, but says nothing about the stated 30,000 clicks, 8 domains, 2 smartpages, or 10 team members. No exhibit confirms or directly contradicts those plan limits.

exhibits.quote: I have purchased one code of $39 and working well. but today, I just created a new workspace and its not taking any links to short.
exhibits.argument: Second workspace not accepting links undermines the multiple workspaces included in 1 Code.

trials.claim: 5 Codes plan includes 350,000 clicks per month, 40 custom domains, 30 smartpages and 75 team members

trials.reasoning: No exhibits were admitted for this claim, so there is no evidence either way about the 5-code plan's clicks, domains, smartpages, or team members.

trials.claim: All future plan updates are included
trials.claimQuote:
- Lifetime access to Switchy
- All future plan updates
- You must redeem your code(s) within 60 days of purchase
trials.reasoning: Reviewers describe new QR-code branding functionality and a product that continues to evolve after six years, supporting that updates were received. Slow development or an unbuilt feature request does not show deal buyers were excluded from updates.

exhibits.quote: The product feels more maintained than actively developed.
exhibits.argument: Lack of active development undermines promise of all future plan updates.

exhibits.quote: I requested a feature in 2022, to which I got the reply that they'd work on it and it is still not a thing.
exhibits.argument: Unfulfilled feature request from 2022 undermines promise of future updates.

exhibits.quote: As QR codes became a thing, Switchy made branding the QR Codes flawlessly simple to do, I stated adding my client links to Switchy as well.
exhibits.argument: Quote shows the product received new functionality after purchase, supporting future updates.

exhibits.quote: This is a solid product that continues to evolve - 6 years and counting....
exhibits.argument: Quote confirms ongoing evolution over six years, supporting inclusion of future updates.
